verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's Router docs explicitly support load-balancing across multiple deployments/keys, per-key rpm_limit configuration, request queueing/prioritization, and cooldowns/retries/fallbacks — directly matching the story of spreading traffic and throttling under provider rate limits. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation that queuing and rate-limit smoothing behave reliably in production (general community complaints about flakiness exist but are not specific to this feature).
